rows.label: Rank 3 - 2-For-1
rows.note: 44,000 standing, 50,000 cr, one each of six Hex Treasures

conditions: Every Höllvania mission spawns 8 Hex Treasures (one 2,500, one 1,500, six 750s); sweeping them, not bounty rewards, is what hits the daily cap.
Keep one of each 750-standing Treasure type (Comic, CD, Sixpack, Mood Crystal, Cereal, Film) uncashed; Rank 3 eats one of each.
bonuses: Loot radar plus a vacuum companion tags Treasures at range.
Steel Path Höllvania bounties roughly double standing per run, about 9,000 per top-tier bounty.

disclosures.title: the drop route
disclosures.body: Main blueprint: 3.70% per Tier 4 Central Mall stage, about 27 stages average. Parts: best is Hell-Scrub rotation C at 5.41% each; Legacyte Harvest tops out at 1.69% and only wins if you kill more than one Legacyte every two minutes including the defense stage. Nearly everyone recommends buying instead.
